_why: Concepts as Buddy would have remembered them after explaining each once. The questions are written separately, blind to the tuning, in blind_questions.json.

concepts.name: binary search
concepts.summary: halve a sorted range each step, keeping low and high so the answer stays inside

concepts.name: two pointers
concepts.summary: one pointer from each end of a sorted array moving inward until they meet

concepts.name: sliding window
concepts.summary: grow the right edge, shrink the left edge while the window breaks the rule

concepts.name: hash map
concepts.summary: keys hashed to buckets so a lookup goes straight to its bucket in constant time

concepts.name: heap
concepts.summary: a tree kept in an array where the parent is always smaller, so the minimum is at the top

concepts.name: dijkstra's algorithm
concepts.summary: always expand the closest unvisited node next, using a min heap of distances

concepts.name: breadth first search
concepts.summary: visit neighbours level by level with a queue, which finds shortest paths in unweighted graphs

concepts.name: depth first search
concepts.summary: go as deep as possible down one branch before backing up, using recursion or a stack

concepts.name: topological sort
concepts.summary: order tasks so every prerequisite comes first, by repeatedly removing nodes with no incoming edges

concepts.name: union find
concepts.summary: each element points to a parent; path compression and union by rank keep the trees flat

concepts.name: dynamic programming
concepts.summary: break a problem into overlapping subproblems and store each answer so it is computed once

concepts.name: memoization
concepts.summary: cache the result of a recursive call keyed by its arguments, top down, versus filling a table bottom up

concepts.name: knapsack problem
concepts.summary: for each item and capacity choose the better of taking it or leaving it

concepts.name: trie
concepts.summary: a tree of characters where each path from the root spells a prefix, for fast autocomplete

concepts.name: segment tree
concepts.summary: a tree over array ranges so range sums or minimums and point updates take log n

concepts.name: quicksort
concepts.summary: pick a pivot, partition smaller to the left and larger to the right, recurse on each side

concepts.name: merge sort
concepts.summary: split in half, sort each half, then merge the two sorted halves in linear time

concepts.name: big o notation
concepts.summary: how the work grows as the input grows, ignoring constants, like n log n

concepts.name: recursion
concepts.summary: a function that calls itself on a smaller input until it reaches a base case

concepts.name: backtracking
concepts.summary: build a candidate step by step and undo the last choice as soon as it cannot lead to a solution

concepts.name: linked list cycle detection
concepts.summary: a slow pointer and a fast pointer; if there is a loop the fast one laps the slow one

concepts.name: monotonic stack
concepts.summary: a stack kept in increasing order, popping smaller items, to find the next greater element

concepts.name: prefix sum
concepts.summary: store the total up to each index so any range sum is one subtraction

concepts.name: bit manipulation
concepts.summary: use and, or, xor and shifts on the binary form, like x and x minus one clearing the lowest set bit

concepts.name: lru cache
concepts.summary: a hash map plus a doubly linked list so the least recently used entry is evicted in constant time

concepts.name: consistent hashing
concepts.summary: servers sit on a hash ring with virtual nodes, so adding one moves only the keys next to it

concepts.name: eventual consistency
concepts.summary: replicas may disagree for a moment after a write but all catch up, like a profile name update reaching server b later

concepts.name: strong consistency
concepts.summary: every read sees the latest write, as if there were one copy, at the cost of waiting on replicas

concepts.name: cap theorem
concepts.summary: during a network partition a system must choose between staying available and staying consistent

concepts.name: load balancer
concepts.summary: spreads incoming requests across servers, by round robin or least connections, and drops unhealthy ones

concepts.name: rate limiting
concepts.summary: cap how many requests a client may make in a period so one user cannot overwhelm the service

concepts.name: token bucket
concepts.summary: tokens refill at a fixed rate up to a limit and each request spends one, allowing short bursts

concepts.name: database sharding
concepts.summary: split one table's rows across databases by a shard key such as user id

concepts.name: replication
concepts.summary: copies of the data on several machines, a leader taking writes and followers serving reads

concepts.name: leader election
concepts.summary: nodes vote so exactly one becomes leader for a term, and a new vote starts if its heartbeats stop

concepts.name: write-ahead log
concepts.summary: write the change to an append only log before applying it, so a crash can be replayed

concepts.name: content delivery network
concepts.summary: copies of static files on edge servers near users so they load from close by

concepts.name: cache invalidation
concepts.summary: removing or expiring cached entries when the source changes, so readers do not see stale data

concepts.name: message queue
concepts.summary: producers put messages on a queue and consumers take them at their own pace, decoupling the two

concepts.name: idempotency key
concepts.summary: the client sends a unique key so a retried payment is recognised and not charged twice

concepts.name: database indexing
concepts.summary: a sorted structure on a column so a query jumps to matching rows instead of scanning the table

concepts.name: b-tree
concepts.summary: a wide shallow tree with many keys per node, kept balanced, used by databases on disk

concepts.name: two-phase commit
concepts.summary: a coordinator asks every participant to prepare, then tells all to commit or all to abort

concepts.name: saga pattern
concepts.summary: a long transaction as a chain of local steps, each with a compensating step to undo it

concepts.name: bloom filter
concepts.summary: a bit array and several hashes that can say definitely not present or probably present

concepts.name: gossip protocol
concepts.summary: each node tells a few random peers what it knows, so news spreads through the cluster like a rumour

concepts.name: quorum
concepts.summary: with n replicas, reading from r and writing to w where r plus w is more than n guarantees overlap

concepts.name: api gateway
concepts.summary: one entry point in front of services that handles authentication, routing and rate limits

concepts.name: websockets
concepts.summary: a long lived two way connection so the server can push updates without the client polling

concepts.name: backpressure
concepts.summary: a slow consumer signals the producer to slow down instead of being flooded
